guide_title.description: Title of the guide from the cover page, e.g. 'Immunofluorescence Assays'

publisher.description: Company that published the guide, as named in the manufacturer block on the back page

document_code.description: The literature or document number printed on the back page, e.g. 'FL_AG_039'

version.description: Version and date printed beside the document code, as printed, e.g. 'V 1.0 2019/09'

protocol_steps.description: The steps of the staining protocol, in the order the guide describes them, from sample preparation through microscopy

step_name.description: Heading of the step as printed, e.g. 'Sample Fixation'

reagents.description: Reagents or solutions the guide names for this step, each with its concentration if one is given, e.g. '4% formalin solution (in PBS, pH 7.4)'

incubation_time.description: How long the step's incubation lasts, as stated, e.g. '10 minutes' or '30 minutes up to one hour'; null if the guide gives none

temperature.description: Incubation temperature as stated, e.g. 'room temperature'; null if none is given

wash_after.description: The wash the guide prescribes after this step, as stated, e.g. '3x for 5 minutes in a washing solution'; null if none

key_caution.description: The single most important warning or condition the guide gives for this step, in one sentence

troubleshooting.description: Every row of the troubleshooting tables

problem.description: The table the row belongs to: 'High Background' or 'Low Signal or Lack of Signal'

vessel_comparison.description: One entry per column of the table comparing ibidi vessel types for immunofluorescence

additional_coverslips_required.description: Additional coverslips required? row, as printed
